title: Awakening of a Thousand Years
next_chapter_hook: When the gears of destiny turned once more, Chen Ji felt the gaze of the Heavenly Dao growing ever more intense, and the endpoint of the countdown seemed no longer far away.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's shattered soul hovered in the Void, those eyes that had witnessed countless epochs staring directly at Chen Ji, as if wanting to pierce through all his secrets. "Cang Yutian's dying warning and the origin of the Tianji Record share the same root." His voice resonated like echoes from antiquity, "The Prophet King from a thousand years ago was not the creator of the Tianji Record, but rather its first host—and you, Chen Ji, are the chosen true inheritor."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji felt something in his mind shatter with a thunderous crack, and a power sealed for a thousand years surged through him like a tide. He knelt on one knee, both hands clawing into the ground, veins bulging. "So... from the very beginning, I was the chess player of this game." He let out a low laugh, that laughter carrying a hint of madness, "What a fine Heavenly Dao, what a fine Tianji Record, treating me as a chess piece and manipulating me for a thousand years!"

text.content: At this moment, Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value burned furiously within him, and a brilliant golden light erupted from his crown, shooting upward. It was the twin forces of destiny dormant in the depths of his bloodline—the forbidden power Cang Yutian had sealed within his ancestors a thousand years ago. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently, "This power... it has finally awakened! But be careful, if you cannot control it, it will devour your soul along with it!"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice was urgent and tense: "Chen Ji, you now face three paths before you! To forcibly suppress the backlash, you must consume all your Heavenly Fate Value; to coexist with the backlash, you can preserve your life but your power will be limited; or to transfer the backlash—but that requires you to personally choose a sacrifice!" His remnant soul was already beginning to dissipate, "Time is running out, the Heavenly Realm has sensed your awakening, decide quickly!"

choice.prompt: The moment of destiny's choice arrives, and Chen Ji must make a decision:

choices.description: Burn all Heavenly Fate Value, suppress the awakened backlash through absolute will. The price is complete depletion of Heavenly Fate Value, rendering the foresight ability of the Tianji Record unusable in the short term.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value returns to zero
choices.visible_reward: Complete control at quasi-heavenly peak strength
choices.risk_hint: Losing the Tianji Record foresight ability, falling into passivity

text.content: Chen Ji let out a long roar toward the heavens, his eyes burning crimson like blood. He transformed all his Heavenly Fate Value into a blazing flame of heaven, forcibly suppressing the surging backlash within him. The agony was like ten thousand ants gnawing at his heart, his body twisting violently in the golden light, yet he clenched his teeth and endured. "I do not believe in fate!" His voice shattered the void, "Chen Ji will never be anyone's pawn!"

Golden light blazed brilliantly, and from within Chen Ji came a mournful howl—that was the unwilling scream of the backlash, yet it was crushed beneath his absolute will. When the light faded, his aura had already transformed, a power fluctuation beyond human comprehension radiating from him. Quasi-heavenly peak, he had achieved it!

choices.description: Embrace the backlash, turn it into usable power. This approach preserves some Heavenly Fate Value, but the backlash will follow like a shadow, potentially losing control at any moment.
choices.visible_reward: Retain some Heavenly Fate Value, can continue using foresight ability
choices.risk_hint: Backlash may erupt at any time, combat power unstable

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made a mad decision—he spread his arms wide, actively embracing that violent backlash. Agony instantly consumed his consciousness, but at this edge between life and death, he felt the true meaning of power. "Since this is a curse, let me transform you into strength!" His body began producing a strange resonance with the backlash.

Golden light and dark energy intertwined within him, ultimately forming an eerie purple-gold hue. Chen Ji's power, though failing to fully reach its peak, preserved the possibility of continued scheming. He slowly opened his eyes, a glint of madness and rationality flickering in his gaze. "Though this path is dangerous, at least... I can still pierce through destiny."

choices.description: Transfer the backlash to a specific target. Mo Xiansheng hinted that this requires sacrificing an innocent, but with proper selection, it allows Chen Ji to acquire complete power at minimal cost.
choices.visible_reward: Complete quasi-heavenly peak strength, no lingering consequences
choices.risk_hint: The price is the extinction of other lives, and it may be detected by the Heavenly Dao.

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze swept across the battlefield, landing on a certain figure. His heart turned cold as iron in that moment. 'To accomplish great deeds, how can there be no sacrifice?' His voice was low as he施展出 the forbidden technique recorded in the Tianji Record—Karma Transfer. The counterforce found an outlet, surging madly toward the chosen target.

A mournful scream pierced the clouds as the innocent target was reduced to ashes by the backlash. Chen Ji's power surged to the quasi-Heavenly Dao pinnacle, yet his eyes held a coldness he despised even in himself. 'Remember today's choice,' he murmured to himself. 'This is the price I must pay for my grand design across the world.'

In the instant Chen Ji completed his choice, the nine heavens suddenly changed color. A Heavenly Dao pressure beyond all comprehension descended from the heavenly realm—that invisible eye, the Heavenly Dao's Eye, had officially noticed this ant who dared to break the rules. The spiritual energy within a thousand miles of the entire Tianqing Sect instantly stagnated, and all living beings felt that destructive scrutiny.

dialogue.content: A thunderous voice exploded in Chen Ji's mind: 'A mere ant dares to steal power that should never belong to you? A chess piece from a thousand years ago, yet daring to overturn the chessboard?' The voice carried overwhelming pressure and fury. 'This seat shall see just how high this locust trying to shake the Heavenly Dao can jump!'

Chen Ji laughed wildly toward the heavens, that laughter full of disdain and madness. 'The Heavenly Dao's Eye? What a grand title!' He pointed one finger at the sky, his voice like thunder echoing, 'Today, Chen Ji shall show you clearly what happens when a chess piece awakens and drags you, the chess player, off your divine throne! The game you set up a thousand years ago—today is the moment I return your grand gift!'

text.content: Chen Ji formed seals with both hands as the Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfolded behind him. The originally incomplete pages actually began to repair themselves. He simultaneously activated the Twin Forces of Destiny, golden and black light intertwining and coiling, condensing into a seed containing the law of karma within his palm. 'Write cause, write effect—is this the ultimate mystery of the Tianji Record?'

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was nearly dissipated, but he exhausted his final strength to cry out: 'Chen Ji! Remember Cang Yutian's dying words—the true power of the Tianji Record lies not in foresight, but in rewriting! But the price of rewriting... is your own fate!' Before his words finished, his remnant soul completely scattered into points of light, merging into the Tianji Record.

text.content: Chen Ji gazed toward where Mo Xiansheng vanished, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes, but it was quickly replaced by determination. 'Master, farewell.' he said softly. 'The unfinished game you left behind, I shall take over; the blood feud you failed to avenge, I shall settle!' His eyes snapped open as he raised the karma seed high with both hands.

choice.prompt: The karma seed pulsed in his palm, and Chen Ji needed to decide how to use this ultimate power:

choices.text: Strike directly at the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.description: Attack the Heavenly Dao's consciousness projection with karma force, openly provoking its majesty. This is the most direct method, but also the most dangerous.
choices.visible_cost: The Heavenly Dao may retaliate with full force
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate the heavenly realm and establish威望 for cultivators across the world
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao's Eye may descend Heavenly Dao Tribulation

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer. He hurled the karma seed toward the nine heavens with force. That seed containing the law of rewriting fate blazed like a brilliant star across the sky, heading directly toward the direction of the Heavenly Dao's Eye. 'This strike seeks justice for all souls throughout the ages who were used as your chess pieces!'

choices.description: Use the karma force to rewrite his fate controlled by the Heavenly Dao, severing the connection with the Heavenly Dao's Eye. This is the safest choice.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to intimidate the heavenly realm
choices.visible_reward: Completely break free from the Heavenly Dao's gaze and gain freedom
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao's Eye may turn its attention to his loved ones

text.content: Chen Ji pressed the karma seed into his chest, golden light instantly permeating every inch of his blood vessels. He gritted his teeth, using the Twin Forces of Destiny as the guide, forcibly severing the threads of fate the Heavenly Dao had tied around him. In that moment, he felt unprecedented freedom—from now on, his fate would be written solely by himself!

choices.text: Preserve power and wait for the right moment
choices.description: Not rush to strike, seal the karma force within his body as a trump card for future confrontation with the Heavenly Dao.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily unable to display full strength
choices.visible_reward: Holding the ultimate trump card, capable of advancing to attack or retreating to defend.
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may continue to probe.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered as he made the choice most befitting his nature. He slowly absorbed the Karma Seed into his body, sealing it at the core of the Tianji Record. 'Not yet.' A cold smile curled at the corner of his lips. 'Since you enjoy playing chess, I'll play this game out with you—though the final victor must be me.'

The Heavenly Eye squinted slightly from high above, its transcendent consciousness seemingly reassessing this insignificant creature. After a moment of silence, a cold voice rang out again: 'Interesting. The first ant in a thousand years to dare respond to this seat directly.' The voice carried a hint of amusement. 'This seat has reconsidered—spare your life for now, to see what variables this chess game can still produce.'

The celestial pressure gradually receded, yet that invisible gaze did not completely disappear. Chen Ji knew this was merely temporary peace. He lowered his gaze to his own hands, feeling within his body that unprecedented power—quasi-heavenly peak, possessing the ultimate ability to inscribe karma. He gently clenched his fist, and the void trembled faintly between his fingers. 'Is this... the power to shatter the board?'

Just then, Chen Ji felt an unusual stirring within his body. Though the Heavenly Fate Value had been consumed greatly, the fusion of the Twin Destinies Power brought him an unexpected surprise—he had gained dual inscription abilities of both 'cause' and 'effect.' From now on, he could not only foresee karma but also personally rewrite it! This was a realm that no host of the Tianji Record throughout history had ever attained!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings, gazing at the众人 who stood stunned by his awakening, a faint serene smile curving his lips. 'Gentlemen, today's matter ends here.' His voice was calm as water, yet carried undeniable authority. 'From now on, the landscape of Tianqing Sect shall change. As for those rats still lurking in the shadows...' His gaze was profound. 'Chen Ji awaits at any time.'

text.content: As night fell, Chen Ji stood alone at the highest point of Tianqing Sect, overlooking this world he had secretly maneuvered for years. His strength had reached quasi-heavenly peak, and he held the ultimate power to rewrite karma. On the surface, he seemed invincible. Yet only he knew that the Heavenly Eye's gaze had never truly departed, and the countdown of fate... had already begun.

He closed his eyes, and the pages of the Tianji Record automatically unfolded in his mind. A new revelation emerged—clues to finding Chen Nian had appeared, and his sister, the one known as the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' might be the key to unraveling the Heavenly Eye. Chen Ji opened his eyes, a rare tenderness flickering within them. 'Xiao Nian, wait for me.' he whispered. 'This time, it's your brother's turn to rewrite your destiny.'

Far above in the nine heavens, deep within the Heavenly Eye's consciousness, a covert ripple quietly transmitted across the myriad worlds. The ancient entities concealed in darkness simultaneously received a message—'Tianji Record host awakened, the chess game shifts, proceed according to original plans.' The masterminds behind the millennium-long scheme finally began to stir. And Chen Ji, this man who had walked the world under the name of a废物, was about to become the greatest variable to shake the heavens.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly felt his heart race—a call from the depths of his bloodline, as though something important was summoning him. He lowered his gaze to his chest, precisely where the Karma Seed was sealed. A foreboding premonition surged within him. He murmured to himself: 'This sensation... the countdown of fate has already begun.' He raised his head toward the distant horizon, determination flashing in his eyes. 'Since it cannot be avoided, let me personally drag this so-called Heaven down from its divine throne!'
